column1: # Relics (Faz 12) — single source: generator/relics.py turns this table into items, models, textures, lang, Curios tags, loot tables, loot modifiers and the jar JSON the game reads (theoria/relics.json).
# A new relic = a new row. Java knows only the effect KINDS below
column2: every number and every name lives here.

column1: # slot    : a Curios slot type from data/curios_slots.csv (the item goes in through the Curios tag #curios:<slot>
column2: the Curios "curio" slot takes #curios:curio).

column1: # rarity  : common | uncommon | rare | legendary (tooltip colour + creative-tab order
column2: legendary only comes from bosses and keeps).
key=value, a repeated modifier list is separated by '|'):
amp=<amplifier>                     a hidden mob effect kept alive while worn (removed when unworn)
fmt=<pct|num|none>   attribute modifiers while worn ("theoria:relic/<id>/<n>", one per relic: the same relic twice never stacks)
pull=<blocks per tick>                     pulls item entities toward the wearer
column3: sneaking switches it off, items the wearer threw are left alone

column2: food=<hunger points>
column3: saturation=<s>      refills hunger on a timer while it is below full

column2: amount=<durability>                       mends the most worn piece of held/armor gear
factor=<0..1>                     removes that share of damage of the tag (1 = immune): is_fire | is_explosion | is_freezing | is_lightning
interval=<ticks>
column3: duration=<ticks>          hostile mobs in range glow

column2: heal=<fraction of max health>             once per cooldown a lethal hit is survived (item cooldown shown in the inventory)

column1: # sources: source:weight pairs separated by '|', the sources are the rows of data/relic_sources.csv (a chest table or a boss). Weight is relative inside one source.
# art     : shape/#metal/#gem — the icon is drawn by generator/relic_art.py (ring pendant belt bracelet charm clover apple cloak pack circlet scale glove anklet feather).
# desc_*  : one '%s' per value the kind shows (attribute: one per modifier unless fmt=none
